main.description: P16 step 8 of com.etzhayyim.apps.mangaka.composeCharacterVrm. Parses the bound VRM with `kami_vrm::parse_vrm` (in-repo) and checks VRM 1.0 magic + humanoid bone coverage (≥18 required bones) + ARKit blendshape minimum set (Happy/Angry/Sad/…) + polygon budget (<50k tris). The conditional edge `dmn:com.etzhayyim.policies.mangaka.vrmBindRetry@1.0.0` routes `valid=false` back to bindVrm for one retry, otherwise the Pregel moves on to attachCharacterVrm. ADR-2605082000 §2 — kind='mcp_tool'. SSoT: lg_mangaka.tools:tool_validate_vrm.
